_comment: Shared project permissions for Claude Code. Blocks writes/edits outside the source tree at the Claude-Code tool layer. Note: subprocess writes (e.g., a Bash-invoked Python script that opens a file directly) are NOT caught by Write/Edit deny rules — they require OS-level sandboxing. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sandboxing for details. Path patterns use gitignore semantics: //path = absolute, ~/path = home, /path = project-root-relative, path = cwd-relative.
